description:
Have you ever wanted to explore your own hometown in Minecraft? Arnis is an incredible open source project that uses real-world geography, topography, and architecture to generate complex Minecraft worlds. By combining geospatial and elevation data from OpenStreetMap, it builds accurate terrains and real buildings. You can customize the scale, spawn points, and even building interiors with just a few clicks.
